anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential over-utilization or resource bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
Trading system shows zero total profit/loss and zero ROI with no active trades, which may indicate a lack of trading activity or issues with strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load average and prevent potential system slowdowns.
Review and enhance AI model training and opportunity generation processes to ensure they are functioning and contributing to trading strategies.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough analysis of CPU usage to identify and mitigate any processes causing excessive load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting the platform's reliability.

recommendations.action: Evaluate the AI system's configuration and logs to diagnose why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
